relevance_note: Single case report of a boy with a de novo TNFAIP3 variant: "the heterozygous substitution NM_006290.3:c.1084C > T was found".
method_note: Rows written by hand into a Python builder in the scratch directory; no table was transcribed by script. In scope: the index patient ('patient', single unnamed patient of the case report); his mother and father (tested negative for the variant, and each described with migraine); and two previously published children from reference (8) ('a 3-year-old and a 6-month-old child with HA20'), included because ages and a lymphocyte finding are given. No variant rows for the parents (variant absent) or for the ref (8) children (no TNFAIP3 variant printed or attributed). Group-level literature cohorts in the Discussion (16 patients of ref 4; 61 patients of Yu et al., ref 6; Schwartz et al., ref 9) give no individual-level facts and get no rows. Contradiction: the Case presentation says 'Fevers started at 7 weeks of age' and abdominal pain attacks 'From the age of 2.5 years', whereas the Discussion says abdominal pains, diarrhea and fever attacks occurred 'since early infancy, from the age of 2 years old'; onset recorded from the Case presentation (7 weeks). Not recorded as features: 'Infections were excluded' (context of the GI work-up, ambiguous what infection) and 'the investigation was normal' for upper and lower GIT endoscopy as a whole (normal investigation excluding nothing more specific; the lymphatic hypertrophy and histologic inflammation are recorded as observed). Imaging showed no signs of inflammation while histology showed mild non-specific inflammation; both rows recorded, checklist GI inflammation observed from histology and Discussion. Checklist: 'no arthritis' and 'no rash' do not exclude the composite items 'arthritis or arthralgia' and 'skin lesions', and negative ANA does not exclude 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)', so those stay not reported. Growth failure excluded from 'His growth and weight were normal' although the patient had intrauterine growth retardation (recorded separately as observed). Variant type 'nonsense' from the text 'changes amino acid glutamine at position 362 into termination codon' / 'resulted in a stop codon'. In silico predictions (CADD, MutationTaster) are not functional assays, so functional_evidence_statement is not reported. The ref (8) statement that 'the concentration of serum IgG was elevated' is not attributed to a specific child, so it was not recorded for either. Vital status 'alive' is from present-tense follow-up text, not an explicit statement. Table 1 and Table 2 numeric lymphocyte values not itemised beyond the DNT values.
